verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. Each leaves the banner almost entirely blank white, shrinks the hero bath photo to a thumbnail-sized speck, and drops the thin yellow frame, so the original's key imagery is lost. In A, the yellow 'LOVE. CARE. KIDS.' box floats alone in the centre with tiny, barely readable text, and the photo speck sits far from it on the left. B has the same failure, but the headline box is slightly larger and sits a bit closer to the photo, which makes it marginally less fragmented; there is still huge dead space on the right and the box is jammed against the top edge.
